message.content:
Based on the search results, the capital of France is **Paris**.

Paris has been the capital of France since 508 AD under King Clovis, with a brief interruption during World War II (1940-1944) when the capital was moved to Vichy during German occupation. Located in northern France on the Seine River, Paris is not only the political center of France but also one of the world's leading cultural, economic, and tourist destinations.
